title: Enterprises winning with AI agents are limiting how much the agents can do alone
summary: It's about who can get an agent approved for production by risk, legal, and compliance teams, and keep it approved once it's live. Enterprises building agent systems now are effectively building toward that requirement, whether or not it's technically enforceable yet.
